name: rulake-marketplace
description: ruLake — witness-anchored vector federation for agentic AI. Six installable Claude Code plugins (one killer-path + five composable) per ADR-009.

plugins.name: rulake-stack
plugins.description: Killer-path install: bundles rulake-core + rulake-substrates + rulake-witness with the deterministic retrieval path enabled and kernels off by default. The 90% case — one command gets retrieval working end-to-end.

plugins.name: rulake-core
plugins.description: The eight rulake_* MCP tools and the rulake_query decision layer. Wires to the live demo at https://rulake-mcp.ruv.io/ by default; switch to stdio for production.

plugins.name: rulake-substrates
plugins.description: Four backend adapters (rvdna, ruqu, gcs, ipfs) plus the two companion MCP servers (rvdna-mcp, ruqu-mcp). Adds 10 tools across the substrate surface.

plugins.name: rulake-kernels
plugins.description: ADR-157 accelerator plane: AVX-512 host SIMD and wgpu portable GPU. Off-by-default; operator opt-in. Includes /rulake-kernel-status and /rulake-kernel-bench commands.

plugins.name: rulake-witness
plugins.description: SHAKE-256(32) bundle verification and witness viewer CLI. /rulake-verify and /rulake-bundle-info commands.

plugins.name: rulake-loop-vector
plugins.description: /loop-aware vector workers — incremental indexing from a backend, refresh-from-bundle on schedule, witness-mismatch refuse-and-replan. The agentic-flow integration.
